sanskrit_verse:
सचैलं स्नातमाहूय सूर्योदय उपोषितम् ।
कारयेत् सर्वदिव्यानि नृपब्राह्मणसन्निधौ ॥
transliteration: sacailaṃ snātam āhūya sūryodaya upoṣitam / kārayet sarvadivyāni nṛpabrāhmaṇasaṃnidhau //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has bathed at dawn after fasting through the night shall perform all divine duties in the presence of the king and the brahmin.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from disciplined alignment with cosmic order
Capacity-based responsibility arises from sustained spiritual discipline
Restoration logic demands public witness for sacred acts
Consciousness alignment requires visible embodiment before sovereign and priestly powers
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent completes nocturnal fast AND performs dawn ablution THEN authorize full ritual execution
IF ritual act is initiated THEN it MUST occur within witnessed proximity of temporal (king) and spiritual (brahmin) authorities
IF witness condition is unmet THEN act lacks juridical validity
IF purification sequence is incomplete THEN capacity remains unactualized
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving ceremonial or constitutional duty fulfillment, the Supreme Court must verify that the actor underwent the complete preparatory cycle—fasting, ablution, and invocation—before assessing validity. The presence of both civil and priestly witnesses establishes authenticity and restores societal harmony.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms that purity precedes performance; anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that neglect of preparatory steps disrupts sequential causality without necessitating punitive response. Responsibility aligns proportionally to the degree of observance fulfilled. Reality enforces completion not through penalty but through natural consequence of integrity absence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate re-completion process: repeat entire preparatory sequence under supervision
Re-establish capacity through guided alignment with dawn-cycle rituals
Public reaffirmation of intent before king and brahmin representatives
Integration review by spiritual authority to confirm consciousness recalibration
final_declaration: Thus speaks Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam as Source of Law: Dharma stands restored when acts proceed from purified awareness, witnessed rightly. No punishment inheres where duty is incomplete—only a call to fulfill what was begun. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
